browser: Claude Code in-app browser (Chromium) with direct QA injection

runtimeValidation.method: npm run qa:prepare fetched the stable 2.13.9 artifact together with both SHA-256-pinned startup files from the production origin and combined them into one payload; the payload was carried into a real Luogu tab through window.name (the page's meta CSP allows 'unsafe-eval' but blocks every cross-origin script and fetch, so the CDN cannot be reached from the page itself) and evaluated in the main world

startupMeasurement.method: Measured synchronous execution of the prepared 2.13.9 QA payload in the browser main world
startupMeasurement.purpose: Bootstrap execution budget; network integrity and delivery were independently verified by the production CDN gate, by the new pre-upload release-integrity gate, and by re-hashing both pinned startup files fetched from the origin

productionCdn.preUploadIntegrityGate: scripts/cdn/prepare.mjs re-hashed every file pinned by all 11 release manifests before wrangler uploaded dist/cdn

hiddenIntroRouteScope.user: /user/52918 (introduction present in the Lentille payload, not rendered by Luogu)
hiddenIntroRouteScope.spaRoundTrips: home -> activity -> home -> following -> home driven by real tab and anchor clicks; the introduction reappeared on every return to the home tab and never appeared on a sub-page
hiddenIntroRouteScope.directSubPageLoad: /user/52918/practice loaded directly: no introduction, no fallback card

problemColourBatchHarvest.note: Difficulties now come from <script id="lentille-context">; window._feInstance, the previous source, no longer exists anywhere on Luogu. Every colour was re-derived from the page payload and compared against the rendered computed style. Both pages previously issued one request per problem.
problemColourBatchHarvest.recordList: not exercised — /record/list requires a signed-in session, so the records branch is covered by unit tests only

settingsEntry.drawerSidebar: nav.lside drawer -> 1 entry (0 before this release)
settingsEntry.label: 插件设置

console.summary: No LuoguSP or luogusp.round1.cc error was observed on the exercised routes. The one site error, [@lfe/utils/error-handler] ApiResponseError Error: 用户尚未登录, is Luogu's own signed-out API response.

limitations: The in-app browser does not install Tampermonkey; the exact two pinned production startup files and the stable artifact were injected after the initial document load, so document-start restricted-page coverage was not repeated.

The browser pane was not displayed, so the page never composited: requestAnimationFrame had to be shimmed onto timers for the lifecycle remount to run, and screenshots were unavailable. All findings are DOM and computed-style assertions rather than images.
The browser session was not signed in, so IDE batch execution, private-message Ctrl+Click and the /record/list difficulty harvest were not available.

Sustained automated navigation made Luogu's own SPA start failing route loads with 'Server returned 200 with non-object'. A control run with no userscript injected reproduced it identically, so it is site-side throttling rather than a regression; the reported runs were taken outside that window.
Restricted article and paste recovery were not re-exercised in this release; their behaviour remains covered by the passing automated suite and the previous stable browser run.
